title: OpenVision 2.14 expands owner-selected AI paths for Meta glasses
claim: OpenVision added ChatGPT subscription and SuperGrok sign-in paths, while subsequent main-branch work moved stored API secrets from plaintext settings into iOS Keychain.
summary: Third-party open-source developer evidence. The project explicitly warns that ChatGPT subscription sign-in relies on an undocumented Codex CLI integration surface; this is useful owner-control experimentation, not a stable vendor-supported capability.
